name: cniska-task
description: Tells every session that queued and running work lives in agent-task, not in a ledger, a notes file or a plan, and names the commands that queue, start and close a task: whenever a session starts, resumes, clears or compacts, it adds that note, and in a directory holding the brief of a running or in-review task, the running and in-review tasks after it as agent-task list --started prints them, each flagged briefChanged when its brief no longer has the sha recorded when the task started. While a halt raised with agent-task halt stands, it shows the halt and its reason at session start and refuses file edits and writes, shell commands other than agent-task alone, and starting agents. It needs the agent-task CLI on PATH and checks nothing without it.
